description: Model side of milestone 6 (plan.md items 1-4, conventions in plan.md section 0): shared voxel-coordinate sampler with border/zero boundaries and a reshape-based trilinear x2 upsample in models/layers.py; new models/diffeo.py (warp, compose, scaling-and-squaring exp, inverse via -v, group-mean centering, displacement upsampling, Jacobian determinant, folding fraction, pairwise and cascade composition); ModelConfig fields deform_decoder (default False), decoder_widths (None = half widths), integration_steps (7); DeformDecoder (U-Net D5..D1, group blocks in A and B, param-free upsamples at finer levels, zero-init float32 SVF head) and the 'deform' task in GroupRegLevelModel with optional tf.recompute_grad. First feature; no dependency on other FEATs. Linear behaviour, variables and transform_image results must be unchanged when deform_decoder is False.
steps: Read plan.md sections 0-1 and items 1-4 fully before coding; read models/layers.py (transform_image, index_grid), models/group_net.py, models/config.py, tests/test_spatial_transformer.py, tests/test_group_net.py.

models/layers.py: extract the gather/blend code of transform_image into sample_voxel_coords(images, coords, interpolation='linear', fill_value=0.0, boundary='zero'|'border'); transform_image computes coords exactly as before and calls it (bit-identical). Add upsample_trilinear2x(x) (per-axis even/odd blend 0.75/0.25 with edge replication, interleave by stack+reshape; static spatial dims, dynamic N) and the parameter-free Keras layer TrilinearUpsample2x. Document the half-pixel semantics (coarse q at fine 2q+0.5) in the docstring.

New tests/test_upsample.py (imports tests.tf_setup first): vs scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates(order=1, mode='nearest') at coordinates (p-0.5)/2 (exact, < 1e-6), vs scipy.ndimage.zoom(order=1, mode='nearest', grid_mode=True) if scipy >= 1.6 else skip, ramp exactness in the interior, multi-channel, dynamic N without retrace, gradient exists.

New models/diffeo.py with: warp(vol, u, interpolation='linear', boundary='zero', fill_value=0.0); warp_field(field, u) (border); compose(u_a, u_b) = u_b + warp_field(u_a, u_b); integrate_svf(v, steps=7) (v/2^T then T self-compositions; steps=0 -> v); exp_and_inverse(v, steps) -> (u, u_inv) with u_inv = integrate_svf(-v); center_velocities(v); upsample_displacement(u) = 2*upsample_trilinear2x(u); jacobian_determinant(u) (central differences, interior only, [N,X-2,Y-2,Z-2]); folding_fraction(u, mask=None) -> [N]; pairwise_displacement(u, u_inv, i, j); compose_cascade(u_prev_up, u_inv_prev_up, u_new, u_inv_new); to_mm(u, spacing). float16 -> float32, float64 kept. Module docstring = the conventions table of plan.md section 0.

New tests/test_diffeo.py with the tests listed in plan.md item 2 (constant v exact translation; exp(v) o exp(-v) round trip on a smooth random field with max/mean interior error printed and asserted max < 0.1 vox, mean < 0.01 vox; compose and warp vs scipy map_coordinates; Jacobian of an affine-like field = det M and vs np.gradient interior; folding fraction; centering mean 0; upsampling consistency; cascade inverse; dtypes; finite gradients through integrate_svf). Record the measured round-trip errors in this FEAT's findings.

models/config.py: add deform_decoder: bool = False, decoder_widths: Optional[Tuple[int, ...]] = None, integration_steps: int = 7; resolved_decoder_widths() = (f4//2, f3//2, f2//2, f1//2, f0//2); tuple-ise and validate (5 positive ints, steps >= 0). Extend tests/test_group_net.py::TestModelConfig (defaults, round trip, old dict without the new keys loads).

models/group_net.py: add ALL_TASKS = TASKS + ('deform',); class DeformDecoder(level, config) with stages d5..d1 (TrilinearUpsample2x where required: D5/D4/D3 always, D2 at levels 2 and 1, D1 at level 1; concat skip L5/L4/L3/L2/stem; _conv_block(cfg, width, 1, True, name, residual_ok=False)), svf head = L.NormAct(cfg.norm, cfg.negative_slope, cfg.bn_momentum, cfg.bn_epsilon) + Conv3D(3, 3, padding='same', zeros kernel and bias, dtype='float32', name='svf_head'); call(skips, training) -> (v_raw float32, dec_feat).

GroupRegLevelModel(level, config=None, gradient_checkpointing='none', **kwargs): build the decoder only when config.deform_decoder; call(images, task, training=None, return_warped=False): 'deform' -> encoder -> decoder -> diffeo.center_velocities -> diffeo.exp_and_inverse(v, cfg.integration_steps); output dict keys v_raw, v, u, u_inv, dec_feat, bottleneck, skips (+ warped = diffeo.warp(float32 images, u) when return_warped); ValueError for 'deform' without decoder. gradient_checkpointing in ('none','integrator','decoder','both') wraps exp_and_inverse and/or the decoder call in tf.recompute_grad (docstring: BN moving stats update twice per step when the decoder is recomputed). build_model also runs one deform forward when the decoder exists. count_params_by_part adds deform_decoder parts only when present. Update the module docstring (deform hook now implemented, milestone-8 cascade hook = diffeo.compose_cascade).

tests/test_group_net.py: add TestDeformShapes, TestDeformCopyWeights, TestDeformGradients, TestDeformCentering, TestDeformPermutation, TestGradientCheckpointing, TestDeformMixedPrecision as specified in plan.md item 4 (use narrow widths from tests.runtime_helpers.NARROW with deform_decoder=True; free_memory in tearDown).
acceptance_criteria: python -m unittest tests.test_upsample tests.test_diffeo tests.test_spatial_transformer tests.test_group_net -v passes (all old test_group_net and test_spatial_transformer tests unchanged and passing)

With deform_decoder=False the model's variable list, parameter counts and outputs are identical to before (existing TestParameterCounts unchanged)
A deform forward at init gives u == 0 and mean_i v_i == 0; decoder variables have identical shapes across levels 4/2/1 and copy_weights_from works
Deform-step gradients: all encoder and deform-decoder variables non-None, all linear-decoder variables None; recompute_grad variants give equal gradients (1e-4 relative)

APIs for later FEATs:
- models.layers: sample_voxel_coords(images, coords, interpolation='linear'|'nearest', fill_value=0.0, boundary='zero'|'border') (coords [N,X',Y',Z',3] float32/64 input voxel indices; output has coords' spatial shape; float inputs keep dtype, int labels keep dtype in nearest); BOUNDARIES; upsample_trilinear2x(x) (static X,Y,Z,C, dynamic N, input dtype); TrilinearUpsample2x layer (no weights). transform_image now calls sample_voxel_coords(boundary='zero') with identical ops.
- models.diffeo: warp(vol, u, interpolation='linear', boundary='zero', fill_value=0.0) (float16 vol -> float32 output; uint8 labels nearest stay uint8; output spatial = u's); warp_field(field, u) (border); compose(u_a, u_b) (float64 if either is float64); integrate_svf(v, steps=7); exp_and_inverse(v, steps=7) -> (u, u_inv); center_velocities(v); upsample_displacement(u); jacobian_determinant(u) -> [N,X-2,Y-2,Z-2]; folding_fraction(u, mask=None) -> [N] (mask full-size [N|1,X,Y,Z(,1)] is cropped to the interior, or interior-size; any dtype incl. bool); pairwise_displacement(u, u_inv, i, j) -> [P,X,Y,Z,3] (scalar i/j allowed, reshaped to [-1]); compose_cascade(u_prev_up, u_inv_prev_up, u_new, u_inv_new) -> (u, u_inv); to_mm(u, spacing).
- models.config.ModelConfig: deform_decoder=False, decoder_widths=None, integration_steps=7, resolved_decoder_widths() -> (f4,f3,f2,f1,f0)//2 = (128,96,64,32,16); from_dict of old dicts without these keys works.
- models.group_net: TASKS=('rigid','affine') unchanged; DEFORM_TASK='deform'; ALL_TASKS; DECODER_STAGES=('d5'..'d1'); GRADIENT_CHECKPOINTING=('none','integrator','decoder','both'); DeformDecoder(level, config) layer named 'deform_decoder' with attributes d5..d1, up_d5..up_d1 (None where absent), svf_norm_act, svf_head, blocks(); call(skips, training) -> (v_raw float32, dec_feat). GroupRegLevelModel(level, config=None, gradient_checkpointing='none'); model.gradient_checkpointing is a plain attribute read at call time (can be switched without rebuilding; retrace tf.functions after switching). model(images, task='deform', training=..., return_warped=False) -> dict v_raw, v, u, u_inv (float32 [N,X,Y,Z,3] level voxels), dec_feat (compute dtype, float16 under AMP), bottleneck, skips (+ warped float32). 'deform' without the decoder -> ValueError. build_model(n) runs rigid then deform forward. count_params_by_part adds deform_decoder/d5..d1, deform_decoder/svf_head, deform_decoder, group_overhead/deform_decoder only when present.
- Gradient routing confirmed: deform step -> every encoder + deform-decoder variable has a gradient, every linear-decoder variable None; rigid step -> every deform-decoder variable None. recompute_grad variants (integrator/decoder/both, eager and inside tf.function) match 'none' (loss 1e-4 rel; grads 1e-4 of the per-variable max + 1e-6 of the global max).

DEVIATIONS / NOTES: (1) The decoder is only wrapped in tf.recompute_grad once it is built (first call runs directly) so variables are never created inside custom_gradient; build_model guarantees that. (2) TestDeformShapes uses tiny widths (filters 4,8,8,8,8,8; decoder 8,8,8,4,4) instead of NARROW: NARROW at level 1 OOMs the 6 GB test cap (D1 group block = 64 float32 channels at 160x224x192, ~1.8 GB per tensor). Implication for later steps: level-1 deform even with narrow widths needs a large GPU; default widths at level 1 will need gradient checkpointing / AMP (milestone 9). (3) The checkpointing test tolerance has a floor of 1e-6 x global max gradient because e.g. the stem conv bias (followed by BN) has an analytically ~0 gradient carrying only rounding noise (6e-10 vs 8e-10). (4) warp() returns float32 for float16 volumes (plan: float16 -> float32), other float dtypes kept. (5) The decoder casts each skip to the running dtype before concat; v_raw is cast to float32 explicitly.

INTEGRATION RUN NOTE (convergence fixer, iteration 1): tests.test_group_net.TestGroupBehaviour.test_permutation_equivariance (pre-existing LINEAR test, unchanged) is FLAKY and the flake predates milestone 6. Evidence: in the integration run it failed once (translation diff 1.049e-5 vs atol 1e-5, config A rigid); isolated reruns of the test: working tree 2 of 8 failed (1.04e-5, 1.24e-5), HEAD 0 of 8. A temporary probe (deleted) printing max(error / tolerance) over the 8 translation checks, 8 processes each: working tree 0.38-0.95 (none failing), `git archive HEAD` export 0.44-1.05 (one run 1.049 = would fail). The model weights differ run to run in both trees (unseeded init), so the error is random and both trees have the same distribution. Cause: t_tol = 1e-5 * max(1, max|t|) while config-A translations are only ~0.1-0.25 mm (the comment assumes ~10 mm), so float32 group-mean rounding sits at the tolerance. Not changed (existing tests stay unchanged per plan section 1); if the final full suite fails only here, rerun the module, or a reviewer may approve loosening the floor (e.g. 3e-5).
